title: Rock of Cashel

terrainReference.basis: Native datum is the retained standard viewer terrain at the mapped enclosure center. Ruin footings follow the coarse retained surface.

note: Current PMTiles footprints control cathedral, round tower, chapel and lower ranges. The prior identity-matched enclosure controls approximate low boundary walls. Heights, broken profiles and ground contact are picture-led and coarse. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.
